summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of IHEZA School Management System focusing on Task Assignment, Classroom, and Academic Hub features. All requested features are working correctly.
passed_tests: Task Assignment page loads with staff list sidebar
Task Assignment shows 'Assign Task' button for Principal
Task Assignment shows 'Print Report' button
Task Assignment shows stats cards (Total Tasks, Completed, Pending, Completion Rate)
Task Assignment shows 'All Staff' filter option
Task Assignment has search input and status filter dropdown
Assign New Task modal opens with all required fields (Task Title, Description, Assign To, Priority, Due Date, Notes)
Classroom page loads with class selector (Grade 1A)
Classroom shows student count (2 students)
Classroom shows 4 task types: Homework, Classwork, Package, Test
Classroom shows task count for each type
Classroom shows 'Assign Task' button for Teacher
Classroom Assign Task modal shows task type selector with all 4 types
Classroom modal has Title, Description, Class, Subject, Due Date fields
Classroom modal shows 'This task will be assigned to all students in [Class]'
Academic Hub page loads with 4 tool tabs
Academic Hub shows Lesson Plans tab
Academic Hub shows Scheme of Work tab
Academic Hub shows Subject Evaluation tab
Academic Hub shows Assessments tab
Create Lesson Plans form opens from Academic Hub
Lesson Plan form has all fields: Title, Date, Subject, Class, Topic, Duration, Objectives, Materials, Introduction, Development, Conclusion, Assessment, Homework
Lesson Plan form has 'Add Objective' and 'Add Material' buttons for dynamic lists
Each Academic Hub tab has its own Create button
Navigation shows correct items per role - Principal sees Task Assignment
Navigation shows correct items per role - Teacher sees Classroom and Academic Hub
Navigation shows correct items per role - Teacher does NOT see Task Assignment
critical_code_review_comments: Task Assignment implementation correctly restricts access to Principal/Director/Coordinator roles
Classroom correctly shows 4 task types (Homework, Classwork, Package, Test) with counts
Academic Hub provides 4 tools (Lesson Plans, Scheme of Work, Subject Evaluation, Assessments)
Role-based navigation filtering is working correctly
All forms have proper validation and required field indicators
context_for_next_testing_agent: Task Assignment, Classroom, and Academic Hub features are fully functional. Task Assignment allows Principal to assign tasks to staff with priority, due date, and status tracking. Classroom allows Teachers to assign 4 types of tasks (Homework, Classwork, Package, Test) to students with class selector showing student count. Academic Hub provides 4 tools for teachers: Lesson Plans, Scheme of Work, Subject Evaluation, and Assessments with create/edit/preview/print functionality. Navigation correctly filters items based on user role.
